description: Use this when someone asks who supplies or delivers natural gas at a Georgia ZIP code, whether they can choose a gas marketer there, or whether Atlanta Gas Light, Liberty Utilities or a city gas system serves an area. Returns which kinds of gas system appear for the ZIP (Atlanta Gas Light, where households choose a marketer; Liberty Utilities; or a named city system), how strong the evidence is (listed or likely), each non-AGL system's phone and website, the Atlanta Gas Light pool group, and the sources. It does not say which system serves a particular household: when a ZIP is split, tell the user to check their gas bill. Read-only. Do not use for electricity, other states, or to recommend a marketer.

zip.description: Five-digit Georgia ZIP code; ZIP+4 is accepted and trimmed to the first five digits

name: lookup_georgia_gas_provider
title: Georgia gas provider by ZIP
